cases.prompt: A key user at Plant West (fictional) asked in the workshop whether we can add the scrap-rate view that Plant East already uses to their connected extruder. Where does this go?
cases.expected_output: Records the channel (workshop). Classifies into Lane 1a as a catalogued use case on a connected machine. Names the next skill for catalogued use cases. Writes a one-line triage record with owner, trigger, definition of done, gate. Priority is UNKNOWN unless the roadmap gives a basis.

cases.prompt: Our site manager wants OD to take over running the energy monitoring and the green production targets for the plant. Can you put that on OD's plate?
cases.expected_output: Refuses as not OD-owned and names Facility Management & Green Production as the owner. Distinguishes supporting with a digital solution from owning the outcome. Returns the refusal with reason and route to the demand owner.

cases.prompt: Plant Y (fictional) wants the standard downtime tile, but the press is not connected and none of the standard system kits fits it.
cases.expected_output: Starts at Lane 1 as catalogued but records the fall-through to Lane 3 on the same demand rather than opening a second intake. Names the expected gates (Cyber Security sign-off, tool-decision gate). Does not invent a priority.

cases.prompt: The request for the new connector was accepted last week. Who signs off the spend and who may approve the connection?
cases.expected_output: Recognises that the request is already accepted and the question is about approvals. Hands it to the decision-rights skill instead of re-triaging.

should_trigger: A plant just sent us an idea for a new dashboard, what do we do with it?
Is this request OD work or does it belong to Manufacturing Engineering?
Which lane does a request for a new machine connection go into?
Someone is pushing for urgent work with no roadmap link, should we accept it?
should_not_trigger: Who has to approve the spend for the accepted connector project?
Write the requirement specification for the accepted demand.
What does the abbreviation MSB stand for?
Prepare the quarterly check of which skills have stale sources.
